tools.name: pulse_analyze
tools.description:
Estimate a causal effect from a dataset and answer a business question.

Provide exactly one of ``csv`` (CSV text) or ``data`` (list of row objects).
Returns the full long-form Pulse report (the same answer an email reply
contains) as the primary text content and as ``report`` in the structured
resu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pulse_analyze · Private data: pulse_analyze · Public sink: pulse_analyze.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pulse_analyze · Private data: pulse_analyze · Public sink: pulse_analyze

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pulse_analyze" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
